acceptanceCriteria.text: Warm-cache jobs do not require npm registry access to obtain the pinned pnpm executable.
Cache identity includes OS/architecture and exact pnpm version; incompatible executables cannot be restored.
Cold-cache acquisition retries transient download failures a bounded number of times with backoff.
A successful cold acquisition populates the cache for later workflow runs.
Cache miss/eviction remains a supported path; cache is not a correctness dependency.
Integrity/version of the acquired/restored pnpm executable is verified before use.
Product proof steps are not retried.
Existing PR/main CI contract coverage is unchanged.
Normal warm-path setup latency does not materially regress from #775.

issue.title: fix(ci): make pnpm acquisition cache-first with bounded retry
